checks.detail: No-go for a wider witness crawl follows the registered stopping distinction. The narrower positive capacity of f83r as a frozen compound description is retained, not represented as a failed visual observation. No matched historical witness or shared innovation is claimed.

f83r's conventional paired-figure explanation remains; f85r2 is the existing ambiguous composite; f10r retains botanical/stylistic alternatives. No unfamiliar drawing is called an error. Full context and finer uncertainties remain linked in the inventory.

The root table distinguishes actual morphology from preparation, qualities and uses. It does not impose a universal herbal template, word meaning, fixed part of speech, source language, numerical drawing gloss or calibrated probability. The purposive three-case selection is explicit.

The report distinguishes native M.652 views from the longer critical edition, the folio-specific Tacuinum transcription from uninspected Gallica pixels, and the Megenberg text edition from an uncollated illustrated witness. The tenth-century date does not become a fifteenth-century copying claim.

The Iris continuation is an example of source-entry boundaries, not a Voynich layout law. Word division across its picture does not license altering Voynich spacing. Image transmission and neighboring text identity remain separate; no literal-caption assumption is introduced.

GDT887, GDT963, historical image-matching closures and the unretrieved q13 lineage primary are preserved. Mixed legacy report exposure is explicitly disclosed rather than hidden under a zero-target-exposure claim. Prior development exposure is not confirmation.

Three selected historical cases, two newly inspected external folios and at most three target descriptions fit the decision. Extra inherited Tacuinum context and incidental facing-page strips are disclosed without becoming selected cases. This review cannot independently certify complete access history.

All three local Markdown links in the final root report resolve; the historical source note's JSON link also resolves. The target inventory's eleven local links were checked when authored. External URLs were not refetched in this review.
